resumo: IT professional with 4+ years of experience across development, support and software quality. I'm a QA at Dataweb Tecnologia, testing the ERP used by optical stores across Brazil, on desktop and web: I automate end-to-end tests with Playwright and Cypress, validate business rules directly in the database with SQL and make sure payment and customer-service integrations reach users in a stable state. Open to opportunities in Porto Alegre, hybrid or remote.
